```json
  },
  "name": "native_diagnostic_inspect",
  "outputSchema": {
    "$defs": {
      "CanonicalQueryMetricsOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Process-cumulative actual query builder / SDK response populations. Not every SDK\nselect/control API uses this query adapter; no server-wide coverage is claimed.",
        "properties": {
          "builders": {
            "description": "Query builders constructed; never interpreted as dispatched requests.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "request_failures": {
            "description": "SDK observer request failures without statement responses.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "saturated": {
            "description": "A count or duration saturated; exact increases are unavailable after this point.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "server_duration_nanos": {
            "description": "Sum of supplied server statement wall times, in nanoseconds; not CPU time.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "source_started_unix_micros": {
            "description": "First observed query-owner event; absent before any owner activity.",
            "format": "uint128",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "statements": {
            "description": "Actual statements received before caller consumption, including failures.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "statements_failed": {
            "description": "Failed statement results.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "statements_succeeded": {
            "description": "Successful statement results.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "statements_timed": {
            "description": "Statements carrying server execution time.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "statements_untimed": {
            "description": "Statements lacking server execution time; absent is not zero duration.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "source_started_unix_micros",
          "builders",
          "request_failures",
          "statements",
          "statements_succeeded",
          "statements_failed",
          "statements_timed",
          "statements_untimed",
          "server_duration_nanos",
          "saturated"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "ChildSnapshotOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Copied linked-operation summary; availability is explicit.",
        "properties": {
          "available": {
            "description": "Actual retained child summary, never the parent's copied metrics.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "finished_at": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Actual owner completion time, when known."
          },
          "id": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/OperationIdBody",
            "description": "Diagnostic identity of the associated operation."
          },
          "kind": {
            "description": "Bounded producer-supplied operation or phase description.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "observed_at": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration",
            "description": "Actual time this relationship was first observed in the parent clock."
          },
          "outcome": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/OperationOutcome"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Explicit owner terminal explanation, or none while active or unavailable."
          },
          "relationship": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Relationship",
            "description": "Producer-declared relationship, independent of interval overlap."
          },
          "started_at": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration",
            "description": "Actual monotonic start time."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "relationship",
          "observed_at",
          "kind",
          "outcome",
          "started_at",
          "finished_at",
          "available"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "ClosedDuration": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "properties": {
          "nanos": {
            "format": "uint32",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "secs": {
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "secs",
          "nanos"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "CoherentRecordBodyOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "All members belong to the same source event; a read never assembles a mixed row.",
        "properties": {
          "coordinates": {
            "description": "Source coordinate convention, absent when not established.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "family": {
            "description": "Versioned source family; native families retain different field meanings.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "family_sequence": {
            "description": "Sequence within this exact source family; absent after counter/admission failure.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "generation": {
            "description": "Source reset/attempt generation.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "norm": {
            "description": "Source norm convention, absent when not established.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "observed_at": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration",
            "description": "Actual producer event time on this operation's process clock."
          },
          "phase": {
            "description": "Actual native/workflow phase.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "producer": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ProducerId",
            "description": "Performing producer and enclosing operation."
          },
          "sequence": {
            "description": "Source sequence assigned before lossy fan-out.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "values": {
            "description": "Complete bounded tuple; large scientific payloads use their existing owner.",
            "items": {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/RecordFieldOutput"
            },
            "type": "array"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "producer",
          "generation",
          "sequence",
          "family_sequence",
          "observed_at",
          "family",
          "phase",
          "coordinates",
          "norm",
          "values"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "CounterIntervalOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Retained additive interval, copied for passive narrower-window reads.",
        "properties": {
          "delta": {
            "description": "Exact retained delta; absence is arithmetic overflow.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "first_ns": {
            "description": "Actual first source timestamp in process-clock nanoseconds.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "last_ns": {
            "description": "Actual last source timestamp, not a fabricated bucket boundary.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "reset": {
            "description": "Source generation/reset boundary affected this interval.",
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "first_ns",
          "last_ns",
          "delta",
          "reset"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "CounterWindowOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Bounded additive history; it cannot be reconstructed from arbitrary point samples.",
        "properties": {
          "duration": {
            "description": "Duration intervals have open intersection boundaries; counts have checkpoint boundaries.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "intervals": {
            "description": "Retained second intervals, bounded by the same low-owner retention.",
            "items": {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/CounterIntervalOutput"
            },
            "type": "array"
          },
          "observed": {
            "description": "At least one actual counter interval has been observed, even if none intersects this window.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "partial": {
            "description": "Retained updates are incomplete independently of requested interval boundaries.",
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "duration",
          "observed",
          "partial",
          "intervals"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "Coverage": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Independent coverage dimensions; loss is not hidden by otherwise available values.",
        "properties": {
          "available": {
            "description": "Whether copied evidence is available at this read boundary.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "counter_overflow": {
            "description": "An exact counter exceeded its fixed-width representation.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "curtailed": {
            "description": "Collection or access refused observations; inspect the independent loss counts.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "dropped_detail": {
            "description": "Old detail events displaced by the bounded rolling ring.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "dropped_updates": {
            "description": "Producer updates lost to contention or attempted after termination.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "enabled": {
            "description": "Whether collection was requested; disabled is absent coverage.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "interrupted": {
            "description": "The owner guard ended without an explicit terminal explanation.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "refused_items": {
            "description": "Items refused by catalogue, field or collection bounds.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "sampled": {
            "description": "Recent aggregates or detail have reduced temporal/detail resolution.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "stale": {
            "description": "The active operation has no sufficiently fresh published checkpoint.",
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "sampled",
          "enabled",
          "available",
          "curtailed",
          "stale",
          "interrupted",
          "dropped_updates",
          "dropped_detail",
          "refused_items",
          "counter_overflow"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "DetailEventOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "One bounded actual-time detail observation.",
        "properties": {
          "at": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration",
            "description": "Actual monotonic event time."
          },
          "name": {
            "description": "Producer-owned observation name.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "phase": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/PhaseTransitionOutput"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Actual phase lifecycle facts when this detail came from a phase owner."
          },
          "value": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Value",
            "description": "Copied value; this event never supplies scientific permission."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "at",
          "name",
          "value",
          "phase"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "DurationSummaryOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Finite duration extrema; no inferred distribution or exclusive time.",
        "properties": {
          "maximum_ns": {
            "description": "Largest complete interval in nanoseconds.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "minimum_ns": {
            "description": "Smallest complete interval in nanoseconds.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "overflow": {
            "description": "A count or duration could not be represented exactly.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "samples": {
            "description": "Completed observed intervals; overflow is explicit.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "samples",
          "minimum_ns",
          "maximum_ns",
          "overflow"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "EvidenceRefOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Exact observed location supporting an explanatory statement.",
        "properties": {
          "generation": {
            "description": "Metric generation, if this is a metric reference.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "metric": {
            "description": "Producer metric name, or absent for an operation/phase fact.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "observed_at": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Actual checkpoint time; absence never means now."
          },
          "operation": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/OperationIdBody",
            "description": "Actual diagnostic operation, including its process instance."
          },
          "partial": {
            "description": "Evidence has loss, reset or bounded temporal/detail resolution.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "producer": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ProducerId"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Exact performing producer, when the fact is producer-scoped."
          },
          "record_sequence": {
            "description": "Source record sequence, independent of a durable append ordinal.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "value": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/Value"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "The referenced value retains unavailable and nonfinite categories."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "operation",
          "producer",
          "record_sequence",
          "metric",
          "observed_at",
          "generation",
          "value",
          "partial"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "ExecutorMetricsSnapshotOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Copied stable Tokio facts. Gauges are independently read, not an atomic scheduler census.",
        "properties": {
          "alive_tasks": {
            "description": "Tokio's approximate current count, in tasks; not a settlement proof.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "global_queue_depth": {
            "description": "Current global injection queue depth, in tasks; excludes worker-local queues.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "identity": {
            "description": "Process-local registration identity, scoped by the enclosing process locator.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "registered_unix_micros": {
            "description": "Wall time this source was registered; counters originate at runtime construction.",
            "format": "uint128",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "role": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ExecutorRole",
            "description": "Fixed executor composition root."
          },
          "worker_busy_nanos": {
            "description": "Sum of cumulative worker busy durations, in nanoseconds since runtime construction.\nUnavailable on targets without 64-bit atomics; not process or operation CPU time.",
            "format": "uint128",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "workers": {
            "description": "Configured worker count, in threads.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "identity",
          "role",
          "registered_unix_micros",
          "workers",
          "alive_tasks",
          "global_queue_depth",
          "worker_busy_nanos"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "ExecutorRole": {
        "enum": [
          "python",
          "worker",
          "canonical_tools"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "InspectionRequestOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Request for copied diagnostics only; it cannot request scientific work or result admission.",
        "properties": {
          "include_related": {
            "default": true,
            "description": "Copy bounded directly related operations; deeper navigation selects their exact IDs.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "numerical_history_policy": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/NumericalHistoryPolicyOutput"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "default": null,
            "description": "Explicit selected analytical thresholds; absent means only common factual interpretations."
          },
          "operation": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/OperationIdBody",
            "description": "Exact operation selected by its diagnostic process instance and sequence."
          },
          "related_limit": {
            "default": 16,
            "description": "Maximum directly related snapshots; effective ceiling is 32.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "version": {
            "const": 2,
            "default": 2,
            "description": "Standalone diagnostic request encoding.",
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "window": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration",
            "default": {
              "nanos": 0,
              "secs": 60
            },
            "description": "Requested recent interval, clamped to observed operation lifetime."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "version",
          "operation",
          "window",
          "include_related",
          "related_limit",
          "numerical_history_policy"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "InspectionTransportOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Checkpoint transport availability, distinct from producer freshness and scientific outcomes.",
        "properties": {
          "checkpoint": {
            "description": "Actual file read, absent for an in-memory read.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "clock_uncertainty_nanoseconds": {
            "description": "Cross-process clocks are not an atomic observation; alignment may be unavailable.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "failure": {
            "description": "Optional writer or transport failure; it never becomes numerical failure.",
            "type": [
              "string",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "partial": {
            "description": "Required operation or relationship was absent/curtailed/stale in transport.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "process": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ProcessLocatorBodyOutput"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Actual process attachment locator, if supplied by the source."
          },
          "published_unix_micros": {
            "description": "Optional publisher timestamp; it is not native fact freshness.",
            "format": "uint128",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "runtime_metrics": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/RuntimeMetricsSnapshotOutput"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Measurements copied from this exact source process publication or live owner.\nAbsent for a standalone operation; the inspecting process never substitutes its own sample."
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "checkpoint",
          "process",
          "runtime_metrics",
          "published_unix_micros",
          "failure",
          "partial",
          "clock_uncertainty_nanoseconds"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "MetricSnapshotOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Latest and cumulative facts remain available after recent detail has rolled over.",
        "properties": {
          "counter_window": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/CounterWindowOutput"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Retained additive intervals for passive remote window selection; absent for gauges."
          },
          "cumulative": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Value",
            "description": "Observed additive work since operation start; nonadditive fields are unavailable."
          },
          "cumulative_partial": {
            "description": "The additive subtotal excludes an absolute baseline or has lost updates.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "duration_summary": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/DurationSummaryOutput"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Bounded owner-local duration extrema, independent of recent retention."
          },
          "generation": {
            "description": "Producer-declared generation of an absolute counter.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "history": {
            "default": [],
            "description": "Time-coalesced actual checkpoint values, with an optional immediate predecessor.",
            "items": {
              "$ref": "#/$defs/PointSample"
            },
            "type": "array"
          },
          "history_dropped": {
            "default": 0,
            "description": "Checkpoints or older retained slots lost specifically to history budget refusal.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "history_partial": {
            "default": false,
            "description": "History coalesces detail, crosses an interval boundary, has gaps or lost observations.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "latest": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Value",
            "description": "Latest published value, retaining explicit absence and nonfinite categories."
          },
          "name": {
            "description": "Producer-owned observation name.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "observed_at": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration",
            "description": "Actual monotonic producer timestamp of the latest published observation."
          },
          "producer": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ProducerId"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Explicit performing producer; absent for unscoped legacy facts."
          },
          "recent": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/Value",
            "description": "Sum of retained aggregates overlapping the request; partial values may include boundary work."
          },
          "recent_observed_end": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Actual latest included aggregate timestamp."
          },
          "recent_observed_start": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration"
              },
              {
                "type": "null"
              }
            ],
            "description": "Actual earliest included aggregate timestamp, including any overlapping boundary portion."
          },
          "recent_partial": {
            "description": "Included aggregates cross the requested boundary, contain resets or have observation loss.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "resets": {
            "description": "Detected generation changes or backwards absolute-counter samples.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "unit": {
            "description": "Producer-declared unit; changes are refused.",
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "producer",
          "duration_summary",
          "name",
          "unit",
          "latest",
          "cumulative",
          "recent",
          "counter_window",
          "recent_observed_start",
          "recent_observed_end",
          "observed_at",
          "generation",
          "resets",
          "cumulative_partial",
          "recent_partial",
          "history",
          "history_partial",
          "history_dropped"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "NativeTaskClass": {
        "enum": [
          "workflow",
          "math_submission",
          "math_job"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "NextObservation": {
        "enum": [
          "InspectRelated",
          "CpuProfile",
          "TimelineCapture",
          "OptionalAllocationProbe",
          "OptionalWaitProbe",
          "AwaitOwnerCheckpoint"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "NonFinite": {
        "enum": [
          "Nan",
          "PositiveInfinity",
          "NegativeInfinity"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "NumericalHistoryPolicyOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Explicit operator-selected thresholds, not universal convergence criteria.\nThe enclosing inspection request retains this policy beside its statements.",
        "properties": {
          "barrier_progress_minimum": {
            "description": "Minimum relative decrease in barrier accompanying a primal-stall question.",
            "format": "double",
            "type": [
              "number",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "inertia_fraction_minimum": {
            "description": "Selected inertia-correction fraction, under one complete factor population.",
            "format": "double",
            "type": [
              "number",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "minimum_events": {
            "description": "Required consecutive source events, at least two.",
            "format": "uint",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "primal_progress_maximum": {
            "description": "Maximum relative reduction in the same native primal measure.",
```

```json
  "description": "Compare supplied original evidence snapshots through the native finite owner. Select exact baseline/candidate generations and explicit correspondence where owner identities differ. Preserve full denominators, ambiguity, unsupported measurement associations and separately bounded sections. Opens no store and performs no scientific execution. Continue only on the exact returned cut.",

{
```
```json
  "description": "Inspect an exact protected run/attempt/relation. Schema view does not acquire data batches. }
```

### `telemetry_profile_capture` — Capture an explicitly selected native telemetry suspect

Exposure: **tool**. Owner: `pse.diagnostics.read_checkpoint + capture + CaptureSession.wait/stop`. Declaration source: [scripts/capabilities/telemetry_profiles.py](https://github.com/paul-heyse/pse-arrow/blob/main/scripts/capabilities/telemetry_profiles.py).

```json
{
  "description": "Associate a selected bounded telemetry observation with an explicit original native CaptureRequest and CheckpointIdentity. Start only the requested finite Timeline/CPU capture against its exact checkpoint/OperationId, then return the intact original CaptureDocument. The original native owner validates operation/liveness; preflight and postcheck preserve process/start association but are not atomic expected-identity admission. Elapsed telemetry time is not CPU time, and late attachment cannot recover preceding samples. Cancelling this attached helper drains capture only; it never cancels or restarts science, starts telemetry services, changes permissions/tuning or launches a profiler UI. Existing output directories refuse. Capture failure, symbols, overlap and loss remain independent of scientific outcomes.",
  "domain": "diagnostics",
  "effects": "Explicit bounded native Timeline/CPU capture and fresh retained output only; native capture owns samplers/exporters and drains them independently of target science.",
  "exposure": "tool",
  "family": "active-diagnostics",
  "guides": [
    "diagnostics"
  ],
  "id": "telemetry_profile_capture",
  "owner": "pse.diagnostics.read_checkpoint + capture + CaptureSession.wait/stop",
  "prerequisites": [
    "Compatible prepared correctness extension and the exact original checkpoint identity/OperationId. Selected CPU capture additionally needs the existing native perf/Samply permissions and tools; none are installed or permission-tuned by this action."
  ],
  "reason": "",
  "requirements": [
    {
      "kind": "python-extension",
      "mode": "native",
      "owner": "scripts/python_extension.py",
      "preparation": [
        "python_extension_native_stage"
      ],
      "provider": null,
      "validated": true
    }
  ],
  "route": [],
  "source": "scripts/capabilities/telemetry_profiles.py",
  "title": "Capture an explicitly selected native telemetry suspect",
  "work_owner": null,
  "worker_calls": [

      "operation": "telemetry_profile_capture",
      "worker": "native"
    }
  ],
  "workflows": [
    "diagnose-run"
  ]
}
```

```json
  "name": "telemetry_profile_capture",
  "outputSchema": {
    "$defs": {
      "CaptureKind": {
        "enum": [
          "Cpu",
          "Timeline"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "CaptureLoss": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Independent capture losses and unavailable owner facts.",
        "properties": {
          "output_exhausted": {
            "description": "The retained output allowance ended collection.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "queued_packets_dropped": {
            "description": "Lifecycle packets refused by the bounded optional caller-composed layer.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "refused_items": {
            "description": "Exporter identity/event state refused by its working allowance.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "sampling_inherited_tasks": {
            "description": "CPU sampling inherits newly created threads and forked tasks, beyond published thread IDs.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "sampling_loss_unknown": {
            "description": "CPU kernel loss was not quantified by this adapter; never silently reported as zero.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "sampling_overlap_possible": {
            "description": "Independently attached related processes may duplicate inherited samples; never sum them.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "source_partial": {
            "description": "At least one owner checkpoint reported observation or thread loss.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "unknown_clock": {
            "description": "Some actual-time facts could not align to the same-host clock and were omitted.",
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "queued_packets_dropped",
          "refused_items",
          "output_exhausted",
          "source_partial",
          "unknown_clock",
          "sampling_loss_unknown",
          "sampling_inherited_tasks",
          "sampling_overlap_possible"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "CaptureOutput": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "A retained file and the readable complete prefix observed by its owner.",
        "properties": {
          "bytes": {
            "description": "Bytes last observed, possibly including an incomplete tail.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "kind": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/CaptureOutputKind",

          "path": {
            "description": "File owned by the capture, retained after session stop/drop.",
            "type": "string"
          },
          "readable": {
            "description": "The published prefix can be decoded in this format.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "readable_prefix_bytes": {
            "description": "Flushed complete packet offset, or whole file length after successful tool completion.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,

        "required": [

      },

        "enum": [

          "Completed",
          "Stopped",
          "Partial",
          "Failed"
        ],
        "type": "string"
      },
      "CaptureSymbols": {
        "additionalProperties": false,
        "description": "Symbol evidence from a completed bounded perf-script decode, never just file creation.",
        "properties": {
          "checked": {
            "description": "Decoder successfully completed; false also covers not selected/not yet attempted.",
            "type": "boolean"

            "type": "array"
          },
          "resolved_frames": {
            "description": "Actual decoded frames with names other than unknown/address placeholders.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          },
          "unresolved_frames": {
            "description": "Actual decoded frames without useful names.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": "integer"
          }

        "required": [

          "unresolved_frames",
          "names",
          "checked"
        ],
        "type": "object"
      },
      "CaptureTargetOutput": {

            "description": "Explicit known same-host alignment availability.",
            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "clock_uncertainty_nanoseconds": {
            "description": "Reported clock mapping uncertainty; missing is unavailable, never exact zero.",
            "format": "uint64",
            "minimum": 0,
            "type": [
              "integer",
              "null"
            ]
          },
          "concurrent_operations": {

            "type": "boolean"
          },
          "locator": {
            "$ref": "#/$defs/ProcessLocatorBodyOutput",
            "description": "OS attachment identity copied from its owner."

          "process": {
            "description": "Diagnostic process instance, scoped independently from OS PID reuse.",

              "format": "uint32",
              "minimum": 0,
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "type": "array"
          },
          "threads_partial": {
            "description": "Thread publication was bounded or unavailable.",
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": [

          }

        "required": [

      "ProcessLocatorBodyOutput": {

              "null"

        "required": [

                    "type": "string"

    "additionalProperties": false,

        },

      },

                "description": "Typed capture answer; it contains no scientific results or result permissions.",

                  "errors": {

                      "type": "string"
                    },

                  },

                      {
                        "$ref": "#/$defs/ProcessLocatorBodyOutput"
                      },

                        "type": "null"
                      }

                  },
                  "observed_duration": {
                    "$ref": "#/$defs/ClosedDuration",
                    "description": "Actual elapsed collection interval from exporter start (no retrospective CPU samples)."

                    "description": "Intervals actually begun without an observed actual end, including interrupted ones.",

                    "minimum": 0,
                    "type": "integer"

                    "anyOf": [
                      {
                        "$ref": "#/$defs/OperationIdBody"

                      {
                        "type": "null"
                      }

{
```
```json
  "description": "Read a selected dirty-path page using explicit task/worker ownership claims bound to current source_sha256 and optional diff_sha256. Empty hunks explicitly claim the whole path; hunk coordinates refer to current bytes. Deletions require absence plus the current Git diff digest. Git state never establishes authorship. Preserve unknown, unrelated and overlapping claims, producer relationships, proposed checks and native lifecycle preflight.
```
